result.description: Fictional compact desktop environmental controller for studio installations and museum exhibits. The Verge S2-240 manages ambient lighting, timed audio cues, and temperature logging through a fanless ceramic enclosure with Ethernet and USB-C control. It is designed as a niche automation appliance rather than a storage or graphics product, and includes a 240-channel scene scheduler, local event memory, and status LED array.
result.title: Orion Verge S2-240 Ceramic Desk Console
result.title_description: Fanless ceramic automation console for exhibit control
